Global Wheat Buyers Face Rising Costs Amid Ukraine War

Global wheat buyers, particularly in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, are struggling to secure supplies due to the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war. This conflict is impacting the availability of wheat from the Black Sea region, leading to expectations of higher costs for consumers. Spanish farmers are also demanding urgent aid due to rising costs, citing the war in Iran as a driver.
